title: tristagma narcissoides

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
